review_locator: PMCID:PMC2700822, Endoglycan vascular-selectin ligand study; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: Endoglycan, a member of the CD34 family of sialomucins, is a ligand for the vascular selectins
decision_basis: The review and cited primary study identify endoglycan as a glycosylated vascular-selectin ligand, with immunopurified binding and recombinant endoglycan-dependent, sialic-acid/fucose-dependent slow rolling on E-selectin.
limitations_preserved: Preserve endoglycan/CD34-family identity, sialylation/fucosylation and divalent-cation dependence, and recombinant/hematopoietic flow context; no endothelial signaling or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3245201, Leukocyte ligands for endothelial selectins; PMCID:PMC3680630, E-selectin ligands as mechanosensitive receptors on neutrophils
primary_title: CD43 functions as a ligand for E-Selectin on activated T cells; CD43 plays both antiadhesive and proadhesive roles in neutrophil rolling in a context-dependent manner
decision_basis: The reviews cite primary glycoform, precipitation, and knockout/flow studies showing that appropriately glycosylated CD43 can bind E-selectin and contribute to activated T-cell or neutrophil rolling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve activated-cell glycoform and species context and CD43 antiadhesive-versus-proadhesive distinction; no universal CD43 relay or SCI inference.
